vetSays.line: 🛡️ Didem, Ivy, Vasyl and Devon met them at the door — 4 put down. Didem, Ivy, Devon are hurt.
🛡️ Rafael, Ivy, Vasyl and Devon met them at the door — 4 put down. Rafael, Ivy, Devon are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ivy, Vasyl and Devon met them at the door — 3 put down. Ivy, Devon are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Didem, Vasyl and Wanjiru met them at the door — 2 put down. Didem didn't come back. Vasyl, Wanjiru are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ivy, Catalina, Vasyl and Devon met them at the door — 4 put down. Catalina, Devon are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Devon strikes the Scarred Buffering.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
💥 The Scarred Buffering SNAPS! No warning. There never is.
Scarred Buffering hits you for 12.
Scarred Buffering hits Devon for 10.
Catalina harries the Scarred Buffering.
Scarred Buffering hits you for 15.
Scarred Buffering hits Devon for 12.
The Scarred Buffering falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 Devon, Catalina brought down Scarred Buffering. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Devon, Catalina brought down Scarred Buffering. Together.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
You catch Catalina telling the fire about Devon. "Devon, Catalina brought down Scarred Buffering. Together." The story's already growing.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big Loud (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Devon, Catalina. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Chloe strikes the Pack-leader Big Loud.
Catalina strikes the Pack-leader Big Loud.
The Pack-leader Big Loud falls.
📺 Devon, Catalina brought down Pack-leader Big Loud, Big Loud (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chloe just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
